title: Crash
intro.text: The price swings like a stock – mostly up, but at some point it crashes to zero. Hit CASH OUT in time! Anyone still in when it crashes gets nothing.
intro.points: Points = 100 × price when you cash out · last round counts double · everyone's score stays secret until the end
